---
title: "Power Flow and State Estimation"
description: "A three-part pandapower lesson using the IEEE 14-bus benchmark."
toc: false
---

This lesson uses pandapower's built-in IEEE 14-bus network to separate two ideas that are often
confused: predicting an operating point from specified injections, and
reconstructing an operating point from noisy meter data.

::: {.lesson-grid}
::: {.lesson-card}
### [1. Power-Flow Analysis](1.0-power-flow-analysis.ipynb)

Formulate the AC nodal equations, solve them with Newton–Raphson, and inspect
bus voltages, line flows, losses, and loading.

**Prerequisites:** complex numbers, basic circuits, NumPy, and pandas.
:::

::: {.lesson-card}
### [2. WLS State Estimation](2.0-wls-state-estimation.ipynb)

Build a redundant noisy measurement set, formulate weighted least squares,
estimate all voltage states, and calculate flows from the estimate.

**Prerequisites:** Part 1 and introductory probability.
:::

::: {.lesson-card}
### [3. Observability](3.0-state-estimation-observability.ipynb)

Explore Jacobian rank, spanning-tree intuition, unobservable directions,
critical measurements, redundancy, and numerical conditioning.

**Prerequisites:** Part 2 and elementary linear algebra.
:::
:::
